items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: I saw him once after that... So he came out and asked me, come on, have some dinner with him. I had some meatballs. But yeah, that's the last time I had son. Never met him anymore after that.

ctx.x: But, uh, so you didn't, did you, did you keep up with Slim during those? No.

After you? No, after the country I did not know. I saw him once after that. I played the keyboarder at Hose Hill Sugar Bowl, which Hose was managing there, and he stayed there with Hose at the hotel, Hoseheader Hotel. And that night we played Jimmy Reed there, Jimmy Reed had a hot number out there. So he came out and asked me, come on, have some dinner with him. I had some meatballs. But yeah, that's the last time I had son. Never met him anymore after that. We never did run in together after that. Cos after then…
Do you know if Slim still has any relatives in there?
